title: Commentary on the Song of Songs, Liber IV
blurb: Origen’s Commentary on the Song of Songs, Liber IV (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–20.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Commentary on the Song of Songs, Liber IV — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks this commentary; Lawson ACW 26 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Liber IV §§1–20 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VIII (GCS 33, 1925), Rufinus’s Latin of Commentary Liber IV. Lawson ACW 26 was not used as wording. This page is Liber IV §§1–20 (closeout).
